Bengaluru Metro Worker Dies of Electrocution Near Trinity Station

A worker involved in Namma Metro lighting work in Bengaluru died of electrocution near Trinity Station. The incident occurred during ongoing work for the city's metro system. This event highlights safety concerns for contract workers engaged in infrastructure projects.
